items.text: A.J. Brown high-ankle sprain confirmed via MRI; placed on IR, expected miss at least 4 weeks (possibly 4-6). Beneficiaries Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas per ETR waivers.
items.why: High ankle from W1 hit; negative X-ray then MRI; standard multi-week absence.
items.implication: NE passing game thinned; target Doubs/Douglas/Henry short-term. Brown stash only.
items.opportunity: Elevated WR targets for remaining NE pass-catchers.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance return Week 2 or 3 per reports, but same left knee with prior PCL sprain/bone bruise history is scary. HC day-to-day; Schefter realistic W2 chance.
items.why: Meniscus trim after camp bang-up; optimistic short absence but prior knee issues raise re-injury risk.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Mayer temporary TE1 if sits. High-upside stash/start if active.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Michael Mayer expanded targets/routes.

items.text: Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh. Team will monitor how he feels this week vs Raiders; status up in air. Rapoport: monitored DTD, testing done.
items.why: Rib/chest hit in W1; left game after big middle hit; Harbaugh cautious.
items.implication: Practice reports critical; if OUT, slot/role opens for Tre Harris or others.
items.opportunity: High target share when healthy; offense EPA dropped sharply without him.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week per FF Happy Hour. Elevated opportunity with De'Zhaun Stribling injury; ETR lists as beneficiary.
items.why: Stribling absence opens WAS targets/snaps; Berry highlights on waivers show.
items.implication: Priority add for WR depth/flex; volume spike potential.

items.text: Malik Nabers return encouraging: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (31% share), 6-69 receiving on limited role post-ACL/meniscus. Emerged healthy after first game since Sep 2025.
items.why: High efficiency and target share on restricted snaps/routes; no setback reported.
items.implication: Ramp-up expected; WR1 upside if volume expands Week 2+.
items.opportunity: 31% target share despite limited routes; clear alpha when fully unleashed.

items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on IR (knee) and signed Jaleel McLaughlin. Sampson out at least 4 games; can drop in most redraft.
items.why: Knee injury early W1; IR designation locks multi-week absence.
items.implication: Raheim Sanders elevated; Judkins low-route committee continues.
items.opportunity: Sanders routes/carries bump; Judkins still limited receiving.

items.text: ETR Week 2 injury report beneficiaries (waivers): McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Bateman/Moore; AJ Brown=Doubs/Douglas; Stribling=Deebo/Robinson; Kamara=Kendre Miller; Omar Cooper=Sadiq/Mitchell; Sampson=Sanders; Tyson=Vele.
items.why: Precise mapping of injured players to available replacements with role upside.
items.implication: Prioritize FAAB on listed WRs/RBs for immediate volume.

items.text: Rashee Rice tiny career aDOT 4.9; Week 1 just 2.5 yards. Only 2 targets (7% share) despite 29 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (near Worthy). Needs serious volume; knee rehab lingering concern possible.
items.why: Routes present but targets suppressed in Walker-centric, conservative offense; low aDOT profile requires volume.
items.implication: Volatile WR3/flex until targets rise; monitor knee and game script.
items.opportunity: High route participation (29/33) but suppressed targets; Worthy also underwhelming.

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in KC debut, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied for team-high 6 targets (22% share), finishing 23-173-1 rush and 3-18-1 receiving. True workhorse role as expected.
items.why: Dominant early-down and receiving share in new offense; forced missed tackles; Emmett Johnson only other RB touch.
items.implication: Elite RB1 usage floor/ceiling ROS if sustained; handcuff Emmett Johnson must-own.
items.opportunity: 29/32 early RB opps, high route/target share, goal-line work implied.

items.text: Kenneth Walker is a full grown man after MNF explosion. Berry hyped the performance as Monday Night Miracle fuel; aligns with Levitan workhorse data.
items.why: Explosive 173-yard rushing debut validated preseason thesis.
items.implication: Must-start RB1; buy-in confirmed across desks.
items.opportunity: Workhorse volume confirmed by multiple sources.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early. Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Low receiving involvement persists despite backfield attrition; Sanders stepped in routes.
items.implication: Judkins more pure rusher; limited PPR upside. Sanders stash post-Sampson IR.
items.opportunity: Sanders route parity; Judkins carries primary but pass-game limited.

items.text: Lions incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No real RB2, WR3, or TE2 usage.
items.why: Extreme target/carry funnel to top 4; confirms no committee dilution.
items.implication: Start all four confidently; ignore depth pieces.

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage: only 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes, 7 targets (all caught). Got only RB carry inside 10; out-routed Gainwell 21-13. Healthy, good CLE matchup next.
items.why: Efficient receiving + exclusive GL work; healthy post-prior concerns.
items.implication: Solid RB2/flex with upside; monitor carry share expansion.
items.opportunity: Goal-line monopoly + route edge over Gainwell.
items.conflict: Points inflated by TD efficiency vs volume.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate usage with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53 Etienne / 26 Kendre Miller / 15 CJ Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opps 18/9/4. Committee persists.
items.why: Even without Kamara, NO split carries/routes; Etienne lead but not workhorse.
items.implication: ETN RB2 with committee risk; Miller handcuff/waiver value if Kamara lingers.
items.opportunity: Miller 9 opps/26 snaps as clear #2; reverse if Kamara returns full.
